articles.summary: TORONTO, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Allied Gold Corporation (TSX: AAUC) (NYSE: AAUC) (“Allied” or the “Company”) herein provides its financial and operational results for the third quarter of 2026. The Company produced 91,195 ounces of gold during the quarter, representing a 5% increase over the comparable prior-year period, at all-in sustaining costs (“AISC”) (1) of $2,378 per ounce sold.
